description: This is a PHP class source file defining the GDPR model for the customer namespace in the OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for managing GDPR entries such as editing status, deleting entries, retrieving GDPR data, and getting expiration data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for managing GDPR-related data in the customer module of the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all GDPR records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GDPR records based on filter criteria encapsulated in the data array.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Returns the total count of GDPR records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records that have a status of 2 and are expired based on the date limit configured.
